Autumn Call 2026
Autumn Call 2026
The University of Vienna invites applications for more than 10 fully funded doctoral positions across a broad range of disciplines. We are seeking highly motivated and talented candidates from around the world who wish to pursue a PhD at the University of Vienna and are committed to excellent, internationally visible research.
We welcome applications from outstanding candidates eager to contribute to high-quality research.
The University of Vienna offers excellent research infrastructure, first-class supervision, and vibrant scientific community. Doctoral candidates benefit from structured doctoral programmes, opportunities for international collaboration, scientific publishing, and comprehensive professional and career development support preparing them for careers in academia and beyond.

Ian Ehm
i
Update: The application deadline was 15 Oct 2026, 14:00 CEST
Please note that applications submitted by email after the deadline cannot be considered.
You can still access your submitted application via the Application Portal.
Please do not inquire about the status of your application. All candidates will be informed of the outcome of the selection process as soon as possible. See the FAQs for general information about the selection process and the timeline.
What is it about
Short Facts
Target group:
Ambitious candidates with a strong academic track record who wish to pursue their doctorate in one of the research areas listed below.
Positions:
Fully funded predoctoral positions
Duration: 3 to 4 years (Prae Doc employment models 1-3)
Working hours: 30h/week
Salary:
According to the collective bargaining agreement: §48 VwGr. B1
Application period:
15 Sept – 15 Oct 2026, 14:00 CEST
Application language:
English
Application mode:
Central online application
Applications must be submitted online only (Email submissions will not be considered)
More Questions? See our FAQs
How to apply
Make sure to start the application process early!
Step 1: Before applying, ensure that you will have completed a subject-related diploma or master’s degree by the start of your employment.
Step 2: Identify the relevant Doctoral School from the list below.
Step 3: Select a position from the list of open positions. Make sure to indicate the correct doctoral school and supervisor in the application process!
Step 4: Create a u:account and then proceed via the “Apply” link below to submit your application.
Please refer to the User Guide for detailed instructions on how to create and submit your application.
Step 5: Make sure you actually submitted your application by the deadline. Note: You'll receive an Email confirmation once your application was submitted successfully.
